sources.title: Run Doujinshi-14B-roleplay API (Easy Deployment & Flat-Rate Pricing)
sources.snippet: puwaer/Doujinshi-14b-roleplay is a 14 billion parameter large language model, based on Qwen/Qwen3-14B, specifically fine-tuned for R18-themed roleplay. It was trained using 4 billion tokens of R18-specific Japanese datasets scraped from dmm.co.jp and dlsite.com, and supports a context length of 32768 tokens. This model excels at maintaining character persona, tone, and first-person perspective ...
